native_and_before_sites.scope: Native and rebuilt byte packets with disassembly for selected event, instance-query and unsigned high-bit sites. Bounds are native C725 metadata or unique rebuilt COFF entry through next function. Site observations do not by themselves establish full CFG or gameplay equivalence.

review_notes: 67 scoped source/native reviews: 50 named-call leads and 17 operand leads. Observations are prioritization dispositions, not whole-function equivalence proofs.

No redundant-getter-only or readability-only edits. Repeated fixed-array address queries, dead native branches, compiler duplication, inlining and register/width differences are deprioritized where the reviewed source path already agrees.
Raw Shape of the Wiitigo instructions gate the upkeep/attack block on events 0x15/0x5100/0xa00; its later 0x1a blocking call is unreachable through that gate. Do not invent a missing blocking path.
Lost Vale and the per-type mana helper have physical play_land_sound_effect calls behind contradictory event tests; ordinary resolution delegates to mana_producer as the source does.
Reign of Terror cached decomp omits a color assignment, but native 0x2390887 stores the sleighted color into the local test before manipulation; source retained.
Blast current instructions retain counterspell validation before a live mode reload and optional permanent validation; no unspecified-evaluation source change needed in this build.

count_types_in_grave or bh,0x10 represents the same bit as full-width or 0x1000; gain-control AND mask differences are overwritten by the following OR 0x30000; Blood Sun mask differences are overwritten by OR 0x1f000000.
Related tutor-result reviews retain Benefaction of Rhonas asymmetric predicates, Telling Time nonnegative test and Weatherlight fallback/reveal behavior.
scope: One native-supported predicate correction covering two Kiora tutor calls. Other 66 reviews scoped to event/call/operand behavior; no blanket semantic closure, full report refresh or gameplay tests.

review_groups.finding: Raw native reachability checks explain extra physical calls in dead event branches; preserve source dispatch.
Actual instructions confirm the cached-decomp-omitted color store and the counterspell-then-live-mode-validation sequence.
Immediate differences are explained by byte-lane encoding or bits forced by the next OR; preserve source masks.
Related tutor-result review distinguishes nonnegative success from !=-1. Only Kiora needs correction at the inspected source sites.
Attachment, control-follow, graveyard, status and cleanup paths retain reviewed native behavior.
Retain native quirks and exact reviewed boundaries rather than changing them to expected card rules.

selected_native_current_sites.scope: Both tutor results must be nonnegative before decrementing remaining revealed cards. Native and rebuilt cmp unsigned 0x80000000 plus sbb implement that result check. Focused predicate sites only; no whole-function equivalence or gameplay assertion.
